flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management expects the positive trend in feedstock inflows and financial performance for the joint venture MMRPL to strengthen and continue.

opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Coming to the operational highlights for FY '25-'26, 10 coal mine blocks, over 200 major mineral blocks, significantly higher scrap including quite a few plant sales, as well as coal linkage auctions, the order for which MSTC obtained from Coal India Limited..." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Gross percentile value transacted through the portal during FY25-26 reached INR797.37 billion.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So I am jumping to the operational performance during '25-'26, company has dealt with INR797.37 billion in terms of gross percentile value that was transacted through our portal." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The internal target is to hopefully obtain RBI approval and operationalize the TReDS platform within FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, our internal target is hopefully FY27, within FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: Management hopes to be able to establish the TReDS platform in the next few months.

opportunities.point: Foreign institutions have been building a position.

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 218 -> 262 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 260 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -28 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Long-term profit and price growth are balanced, suggesting fair valuation.

threats.point: Management notes that scrap has always been a cyclical thing and the steel sector is very cyclical.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "But scrap has always been a cyclical thing. The steel sector as such is very cyclical." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.
